title: Boy, three, dies after ‘medical emergency’ at Greater Manchester nursery
summary_full: Police are investigating death of child three days after emergency services were called to Cosy Toes nursery in MiddletonA three-year-old boy has died after a “medical emergency” at a nursery in Greater Manchester.Emergency services were called to Cosy Toes nursery in Middleton, near Manchester, on the afternoon of 2 November after “reports of a concern for a child”.
